_readme: Saloon props for the Meshy trial. Each entry: the Meshy prompt, the real-world size in metres (x = width, y = height, z = depth) the model is scaled to, how it sits ('floor' = bottom on the ground, 'wall' = back against a wall), and a placeholder colour used until assets/props/<id>.glb exists. tools/meshy_fetch.py generates the models from these prompts.
style: 1880s American frontier saloon, realistic, worn and weathered, hand-made, single object on its own, no background, no base, game asset

card_table.prompt: round wooden poker table with worn green felt top and four sturdy turned legs

chair.prompt: simple wooden saloon chair with a spindle back, scuffed dark varnish

bar_stool.prompt: tall round wooden bar stool with a foot ring, worn seat

upright_piano.prompt: old upright piano in dark walnut with ivory keys, brass candle holders, scratched finish

barrel.prompt: oak whiskey barrel with iron hoops, weathered staves

oil_lamp.prompt: kerosene table lamp with a clear glass chimney and a brass base

whiskey_bottle.prompt: dark glass whiskey bottle with a faded paper label and a cork

deer_head.prompt: mounted stag head hunting trophy with large antlers on a wooden plaque

framed_painting.prompt: oil painting of a mountain landscape in an ornate gilded wooden frame

wall_sconce.prompt: wall-mounted kerosene lamp on an iron bracket with a glass chimney and a tin reflector
